description: The plot on the right side of Figure 4 displays the relationship between the Accuracy@1 on geometry problems (Geomverse) and tree width for rollout search. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" and is a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" and is a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35. The line in the plot is blue, with a solid line style. The line starts at a value of 26.7% at the first data point, increases to a peak of 34.4% at the third data point, then decreases to 24.4% at the fifth data point, and finally decreases to 20.0% at the last data point.
